geometry_contract.immigrant_independence: lift models retain true smooth immigrant density; never flatten immigrant background to cells
geometry_contract.projection_measure: inherited projected area km^2; all nine fixed cells; actual parents
geometry_contract.isotropy: Radial D_sigma factor is isotropic in the declared projection; the full b_ref-weighted truncated offspring density generally is not isotropic or translation invariant.

background.cell: inherited hierarchical positive b_cell; every zone at least30 training events
background.selection: maximize training spatial LOO sum log density; exact ties smaller h; all six candidate scores retained
background.loo: remove exactly the scored row identity from KDE and hierarchical zone/cell counts; use N-1 components; retain duplicate-coordinate OTHER observations
background.denominator: each retained kernel has its own finite-domain integral F_j; no aggregate common normalization
background.full_fit: after h selection freeze fulltraining KDE including self contributions for proper point-process likelihood; report plug-in in-sample reuse/optimism
background.freeze: one h per fold shared across all smoothbg temporal/spatial models and sensitivity; no heldout or dynamic KDE updates
background.support: fixed domain; inherited zone>=30 ensures positive bcell and leave-one-out bcell; positive q2 kernel also supports sparse areas
background.rationale: fixed .05 broad inherited component regularizes sparse regions without fitted mixing weight; not physically identified
background.interpretation: Training KDE estimates marginal observed spatial concentration, which may contain offspring clustering; it is a predictive nuisance and does not identify true immigrant geography.

fit_policy.nonnested: cell vs smooth backgrounds and continuous vs lift spatial families are NOT nested; do not reuse cross-family fits as guaranteed floors

Independently evaluate generating truth train/test scores as NONFIT witnesses, never insert truth into optimizer candidate pool. For actual containing temporal/bg/continuous family at sigma50 require selected training NLL<=truth NLL+1e-4; all other families have no truth-witness inequality.
synthetic.zone_eligibility: Observed every-zone>=30 requirement does not apply to known-nuisance synthetic overrides; synthetic eligibility is min_train50/min_test20 and positive normalized known bg/ref. Real KDE selection fixtures require positive LOO zones but do not claim observed eligibility.
synthetic.rng_consumption: Clock stream: one guarded openU per inverse-exponential immigrant interval; each chronological parent draws offspring count with pinned numpy Generator.poisson; each ML offspring draws mode with pinned Generator.choice then guarded openU inverse-exponential lag; each Omori offspring draws guarded openU inverse-survival lag. Mark stream: one guarded openU inverse-exponential Q per chronological retained event. Location stream: knownuniform immigrant uses two guarded openU coordinates; knownsmooth immigrant first draws guarded openU mixture choice, then either two guarded openU uniform coordinates or pinned Generator.integers(0,2) center choice followed by guarded openU radius/angle pairs until in domain; retained offspring uses guarded radius/angle pairs only if childtime<horizon. Invalid continuous endpoints fail without resampling; rejection outside domain is declared law.
synthetic.capacity_guard: At most1500retained+pending events,300000total spatial proposals,300000Poisson offspring proposals for any single parent,90wallseconds/history; check wall/queue bounds within each offspring iteration and before any queue insertion. Any cap failure retains the fixed-seed partial history, no redraw.

reporting.training_objective: Proper point-process intensity functional evaluated with full-training plug-in spatial nuisance; a conditional fitting criterion with self-reuse, not an unconditional generative maximum-likelihood or score-information identity claim. Heldout forecast score uses only frozen training nuisance and predictable history.
reporting.reference: Shared training-derived b_ref is conditional and noisy, not exogenous; close chronologically earlier training/test locations are legitimate predictive information, not automatically leakage.
reporting.whole_procedure_contrasts: Omori_cell_cont-fixedML_cell_lift and Omori_smooth_cont-fixedML_cell_lift use current common baseline-selected sigma, same nuisance recipe and proper area measure; not historical independently selected lift.
reporting.matching_precision: Matched means same temporal family, bg/spatial roster and shared baseline-selected sigma. Each free temporal/spatial/bg procedure refits its own a,d,n and free tau or c,p; cont/lift and bg contrasts are fitted procedure comparisons, not fixed-parameter geometric or nuisance-only effects. Shared-parameter ground invariance is a separate machine identity.
